caption: The viral brothy beef bowl… but make it toddler-friendly 🤍 I made my own creamy version using @Kettle and Fire Beef Bone Broth and turned it into a dinner my toddler AND the rest of the family can enjoy. The broth is really what brings the whole bowl together 🙌 I used Kettle & Fire as the base to make it flavorful and comforting while keeping the recipe simple enough for a weeknight dinner. Save this one! 👇 Toddler-Friendly Creamy Brothy Beef Bowl Beef • 1 lb ground beef • 1 cup grated carrot • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp paprika • Black pepper, optional Creamy broth • 2 cups  Beef Bone Broth • 1 tbsp tomato paste • 1 garlic clove, minced • ¼ cup heavy cream • ¼ cup finely shredded cheddar • ½ tsp Italian seasoning To serve: cooked rice + optional parsley How to make it: Brown the ground beef and grated carrot with the seasonings until cooked through and golden. Sauté garlic for 30 seconds, then add tomato paste and cook for 1–2 minutes. Pour in the Beef Bone Broth, add Italian seasoning, and simmer for 5 minutes. Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream and cheddar until creamy. Add rice to your bowl, top with the beef, and ladle that creamy broth over everything. 🤍 For toddlers, I like adding enough broth to make the rice extra soft and saucy. For the adults, add cucumber, parsley, black pepper, or red pepper flakes. One dinner for the whole family 🙌 #kfpartner #toddlermeals #familydinner #toddlerrecipes #easyfamilymeals
